name: Bing Wallpaper
complete-description:
Bing's picture of the day, usable as a face's page background rather than a tile of its own — that's what `tile: false` means here, and why it doesn't show up as an installable tile the way the others do by default. Also supplies its picture as ordinary image content, so a theme that wants it as a tile instead can still use it that way.

The simplest richness scale of any module here, deliberately: the picture is always sent, and the only real question is whether there's room for Bing's copyright line underneath it.
